name: condom
definition: sheath worn on the penis or in the vagina as a contraceptive and barrier.

name: dental dam
definition: thin sheet used as an oral barrier.

name: breast pump
definition: pump that expresses milk (power source and single or double are attributes).

name: wearable breast pump
definition: pump worn inside the bra, whose form differs from a corded pump.

name: nursing pad
definition: pad worn in the bra to absorb leaked milk.
notes: Lansinoh disposable, Bamboobies and Kindred Bravely washable pads listed.

name: nipple cream
definition: cream for sore nipples while breastfeeding.

name: first-aid kit [Verbandkasten]
definition: kit sold, standardised and compared as one object, whatever place or vehicle it is made for; the standard and class it meets are `standard_met`.
notes: Kits sold by DIN 13164 (car), 13157 (work), 13169, and BS 8599-1.

name: adhesive bandage
definition: small dressing on an adhesive strip (UK plaster).

name: triangular bandage
definition: triangle of cloth used as a sling or to hold a dressing.

name: neck support
definition: collar or brace that supports the neck.

name: elbow support
definition: brace or sleeve that supports the elbow.

name: wrist and hand support
definition: brace, splint or sleeve that supports the wrist or hand.

name: orthotic insole
definition: insole made to treat or support the foot.

name: compression stocking
definition: stocking with graded pressure made for a labelled medical purpose.

name: leg prosthesis
definition: artificial leg or part of a leg.

name: arm prosthesis
definition: artificial arm, hand or part of one.

name: breast prosthesis
definition: artificial breast, including breast forms and packers.

name: eye prosthesis
definition: artificial eye.
notes: Hospital page shows custom acrylic eyes made and fitted; not a shop page.

name: epithesis
definition: prosthesis replacing a facial or other external part.
notes: Custom silicone artificial ear (maxillofacial prosthesis) by a Hong Kong maker.

name: blood-pressure monitor cuff or part
definition: cuff, tube or other part made for a blood-pressure monitor.

name: glucose test strip
definition: one-use strip read by a blood glucose meter.

name: CGM sensor
definition: replacement sensor for a continuous or flash glucose monitor.
notes: Page shows Libre and Dexcom sensors by name with 15-day wear; no explicit replacement-sensor sale.

name: hearing-aid battery
definition: battery made to power a hearing aid.

name: ear tip
definition: dome or tip fitted to a hearing aid in the ear canal.

name: wheelchair accessory made for one model
definition: part or accessory made to fit one wheelchair model, including a cushion shaped for it.
notes: Quickie armrest lists compatible models Argon2, Krypton, Xenon2.

name: spectacle frame
definition: frame sold for glazing (a frame with plano or no lenses sold as fashion is not here).

name: spectacle lens
definition: lens sold for glazing.
notes: Varilux progressive lens lines shown on professional page; lenses for glazing implied.

name: contact-lens solution
definition: solution for cleaning, storing or rinsing contact lenses.
